akkan_attacker.description: Akkan melee damage dealer. Void-enhanced combat.

akkan_bulwark.description: Akkan fortress. Unmovable anchor in combat. Taunts, area denial, and damage reflection keep enemies locked on. Aggro control and AoE disruption.

akkan_rune.description: Akkan rune specialist. Inscribes explosive sigils that detonate on command. Ground-targeted area damage and protective wards for allies.

akkan_seer.description: Akkan void bender. Warps space and drains energy from reality itself. Mitigates enemy resistances, slows regeneration, and commands the battlefield through spatial manipulation.

akkan_shaman.description: Akkan spirit healer. Calls upon ancestral spirits to restore and protect. Totemic auras, hex stuns, and sustained damage for solo play. All classes have long and short range.

akkan_stalker.description: Akkan stealth damage dealer. Ambush tactics.

gm_akkan.description: Game Master role for Akkan admins. All permissions enabled.

gm_human.description: Game Master role for Human admins. All permissions enabled.

gm_synthetic.description: Game Master role for Synthetic admins. All permissions enabled.

human_cleric.description: Human divine healer. Channels sacred light to mend wounds and protect the party. Auras, stuns, and enough damage to clear solo. All classes have long and short range.

human_guardian.description: Human bulwark. Intercepts danger and holds the line. Taunt, shield walls, and counter-attacks protect the party. Aggro management and AoE damage.

human_marksman.description: Human ranged damage dealer. Precise shots from afar.

human_sorcerer.description: Human magical damage dealer. Arcane devastation.

human_temporalist.description: Human time weaver. Manipulates the flow of time itself - slowing enemies, hastening allies, and warping space. Revives, teleports, and controls the pace of battle.

human_warrior.description: Human melee damage dealer. Strong physical attacks and battle cries.

synthetic_conduit.description: Synthetic energy conduit. Redistributes power throughout the party. Shields, energy transfer, AoE healing bursts, and enough damage to self-level. All classes have long and short range.

synthetic_exploiter.description: Synthetic combat unit. Exploits system vulnerabilities and weaponizes network latency. Surgically efficient - every strike calculated, every movement optimized. Energy-powered exploit techniques.

synthetic_overclocker.description: Synthetic chronomancy unit. Manipulates system clocks and processing cycles. Slows enemy operations, accelerates ally throughput, and teleports team members through network space.

synthetic_psion.description: Synthetic magical damage dealer. System-mage hybrid.

synthetic_tracker.description: Synthetic ranged damage dealer. Fires from the shadows.

synthetic_warden.description: Synthetic defensive matrix. Locks down threat vectors and redistributes incoming damage. Agile positioning, deaggro, and counter-exploits. Aggro and protection.

wep_attacker_sword.description: Akkan steel drawn thin and quenched in deepwater. The edge drinks the light that touches it.

wep_bulwark_towershield.description: A slab of akkan wall-iron, wide enough to hide the shield-bearer and stubborn enough to hide the one behind them.

wep_cleric_staff.description: Ashwood grown slow and set with a dawnstone ferrule. It steadies the hand that mends the line.

wep_conduit_wand.description: A pale wand threaded with silver conduit, humming low when held near its twin. It carries a gift from one hand to another.

wep_copper_cleaver.description: A short copper cleaver with a cord-wrapped haft. It does not cleave much, but it starts every job.

wep_exploiter_fang.description: A matched pair of thin blades, each edge a fracture line waiting for the right angle. Efficiency is the whole doctrine.

wep_golden_axe_high.description: A golden war axe worked for the golden fords. Cut at the golden rung and kept honest by use.

wep_golden_estoc.description: A thrusting blade tinned thin enough to find the seam in any ring coat. Mercenary make: heavier in the wallet than the hand.

wep_guardian_maul.description: A weighted head on a banded haft, meant to be set against a charge and swung once. The line it holds does not move.

wep_iron_axe.description: Splits firewood before breakfast and wolves after it. The edge remembers a tree's grain.

wep_iron_crossbow.description: An iron-bowed crossbow on a timber stock, wound by windlass and loosed flat. It trades the bow's reach for a bolt that never tires of flying.

wep_iron_dagger.description: Nine inches of honest iron. The quayside answer to everything bigger.

wep_iron_spear.description: A haft of Haven timber, a straight head, and polite range. Keeps horns and teeth at arm's length.

wep_iron_sword.description: A sturdy iron blade. Basic but reliable.

wep_longbow.description: A longbow of layered timber, the string a Kelp Fiber cord that has never once chafed wet. It sings lower than it looks.

wep_marksman_bow.description: Layered yew and a kelp-fiber string, drawn to the ear. The arrow leaves before the target hears the draw.

wep_mythril_crossbow_high.description: A mythril crossbow worked for the mythril barrows. Cut at the mythril rung and kept honest by use.

wep_mythril_halberd.description: The pale metal lets a long pole stay a horseman's weight. The edge sheds light on the backswing; veterans fight it by ear.

wep_mythril_shortblade.description: A short blade forged from gathered mythril shards, light enough to forget and sharp enough not to.

wep_mythril_spear_high.description: A mythril war spear worked for the deep seam. Cut at the mythril rung and kept honest by use.

wep_mythril_wand_high.description: A mythril wand worked for the pale shelf. Cut at the mythril rung and kept honest by use.

wep_overclocker_staff.description: A staff ringed with concentric bands, each one a gear of the world's slow turning. Held, it makes the turning hurry.

wep_psion_staff.description: A focus-staff cored with a filament that answers thought faster than the hand can move.

wep_rune_staff.description: Rowan-and-iron staff carved with a marching column of sigils. Each one was earned in a skirmish and remembers the skirmish.

wep_seer_wand.description: A wand of blackened bone and a single obsidian bead, heavy with the weight of things not yet seen.

wep_shaman_staff.description: A totem-staff crowned with feathers and riverbone. The ancestors speak through it, and the shaman listens.

wep_silver_rapier.description: A slim silver blade, sinew-wrapped and quick. It argues in a straight line and wins on the second point.

wep_silver_sword_high.description: A silver arming sword worked for the low marches. Cut at the silver rung and kept honest by use.

wep_silver_warhammer.description: A silver head on an iron haft, weighted to fall. Slower than the rapier and it does not care.

wep_skyforged_bow_high.description: A skyforged war bow worked for the outer air. Cut at the skyforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_skyforged_fang_high.description: A skyforged shortblade worked for the skyward stair. Cut at the skyforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_skyforged_maul_high.description: A skyforged maul worked for the outer air. Cut at the skyforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_skyforged_sword_high.description: A skyforged arming sword worked for the roof of the world. Cut at the skyforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_sorcerer_staff.description: A spiral of storm-cut timber around a shard of conduit glass. The glass remembers the storm; the sorcerer answers it.

wep_stalker_fang.description: An akkan dagger weighted for the ambush. The void between heartbeats is the one it hunts.

wep_starmetal_bow_high.description: A starmetal war bow worked for the high crags. Cut at the starmetal rung and kept honest by use.

wep_starmetal_crossbow_high.description: A starmetal crossbow worked for the windward shelf. Cut at the starmetal rung and kept honest by use.

wep_starmetal_fang_high.description: A starmetal shortblade worked for the high crags. Cut at the starmetal rung and kept honest by use.

wep_starmetal_master_attacker.display_name: Starmetal Arming Sword of the Attacker
wep_starmetal_master_attacker.description: A master's arming sword in starmetal, fitted to the Attacker's grip and nothing else. It is signed once and re-signed by every hand it passes to.

wep_starmetal_master_bulwark.description: A master's tower shield in starmetal, fitted to the Bulwark's grip and nothing else. It is signed once and re-signed by every hand it passes to.

wep_starmetal_master_tracker.description: A master's crossbow in starmetal, fitted to the Tracker's grip and nothing else. It is signed once and re-signed by every hand it passes to.

wep_starmetal_master_warden.description: A master's tower shield in starmetal, fitted to the Warden's grip and nothing else. It is signed once and re-signed by every hand it passes to.

wep_starmetal_master_warrior.display_name: Starmetal Arming Sword of the Warrior
wep_starmetal_master_warrior.description: A master's arming sword in starmetal, fitted to the Warrior's grip and nothing else. It is signed once and re-signed by every hand it passes to.

wep_starmetal_maul_high.description: A starmetal maul worked for the starfall reach. Cut at the starmetal rung and kept honest by use.

wep_starmetal_skysplitter.description: The Concord charter names it the Starmetal Greatblade and would prefer you did not nickname it. The Concord has signed a great many things it would prefer people did not nickname.

wep_starmetal_spear_high.description: A starmetal war spear worked for the windward shelf. Cut at the starmetal rung and kept honest by use.

wep_starmetal_sword_high.description: A starmetal arming sword worked for the starfall reach. Cut at the starmetal rung and kept honest by use.

wep_sunforged_axe_high.description: A sunforged war axe worked for the sun-touched rim. Cut at the sunforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_sunforged_crossbow_high.description: A sunforged crossbow worked for the sun-touched rim. Cut at the sunforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_sunforged_spear_high.description: A sunforged war spear worked for the skyward stair. Cut at the sunforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_sunforged_sword_high.description: A sunforged arming sword worked for the long ascent. Cut at the sunforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_sunforged_wand_high.description: A sunforged wand worked for the long ascent. Cut at the sunforged rung and kept honest by use.

wep_temporalist_staff.description: A crystal hourglass the sand refuses to leave. It marks the moment a working should have landed, and lands it there.

wep_tracker_crossbow.description: A compact crossbow with a silent latch and a lens of ground glass. The shot arrives before the report does.

wep_walnut_staff.description: Black walnut, moon-grown, with a silver ferrule the smith set by hand. Storms lean toward it.

wep_warden_towershield.description: A broad lock-plate shield, scalloped to seat against a companion's back and share the weight of the line.

wep_warrior_sword.description: A Concord-pattern blade, its fuller stamped with the muster mark of the Haven levy. It has kept more farmsteads than any banner.

wep_willow_wand.description: A willow rod banded with silver, light as a switch and warm as a hand. It does not work much on its own; it only helps.

wep_wooden_bow.description: A simple bow carved from oak. Good for beginners.

wep_zenithforged_axe_high.description: A zenithforged battleaxe, heavy enough that the swing carries the whole body behind it. Cut at the top rung and kept honest by use.

wep_zenithforged_bow_high.description: A zenithforged war bow, drawn for the outer air. At the top rung the wind stops arguing and the arrow goes where it was told.

wep_zenithforged_crossbow_high.description: A zenithforged crossbow, cranked and patient. It does not need the sky's permission to put a bolt through something.

wep_zenithforged_fang_high.description: A zenithforged shortblade, quick as a held breath. The top rung favors the hand that strikes before the eye follows.

wep_zenithforged_maul_high.description: A zenithforged maul, slow and final. It was made for the things that stand between a body and the roof of the world.

wep_zenithforged_shield_high.description: A zenithforged bulwark, wide as a door and just as stubborn. It was made for the one who stands still so the others can walk on.

wep_zenithforged_spear_high.description: A zenithforged war spear, long enough to reach the fight before the fight reaches back. Cut at the top rung and kept honest by use.

wep_zenithforged_staff_high.description: A zenithforged staff, cut for the ones who read the sky and write it down. It carries the top rung's quiet the way a cup carries water.

wep_zenithforged_sword_high.description: A zenithforged arming sword, worked for the top of the world and the last rung the Concord writes. It keeps its edge past the air where the weather gives up.

wep_zenithforged_wand_high.description: A zenithforged wand, small for how much it holds. The Concord signs these last, and only for hands it has watched.

arm_attacker_chest.description: Segmented akkan plate that swallows the glow of a struck rune. The void it rides never lets go of the hand.

arm_bulwark_pauldrons.description: Pauldrons and chest plated into one unbroken shell. The akkan fortress is not a metaphor; it is what you are wearing.

arm_cartographer_belt.description: Buckles for straightedge, plumb, and chalk. The Concord signs its charts and its deeds with the same hand.

arm_cleric_chest.description: Mourning cloth bleached pale and re-stitched for the tending of the living, not the burying of the dead.

arm_conduit_chest.description: Light plates woven with conduit filigree, built to pass a charge straight through without spilling a spark.

arm_copper_helm.description: A copper cap over a leather lining. It turns a glancing blow and teaches you to duck the rest.

arm_exploiter_chest.description: Light hide plates with a laced, segmented core, so the wearer moves a half-step ahead of the blow.

arm_golden_boots_high.description: Golden leather gear for the golden fords. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_golden_scale_chest.description: Overlapped scales of tempered gold. Against rust and salt it is peerless; against pride, hopeless.

arm_guardian_chest.description: Door-plank steel banded across the chest and shoulder. It has turned away wolves, weather, and one very confused agent.

arm_iron_mail_chest.description: Riveted rings the forge cut from its own slag-scarred stock. Heavy, honest, and priced like an apology to the shoulders.

arm_leather_boots.description: The tanner's own pattern, soled for gravel, mud, and the capitol's waxed floors.

arm_leather_chest.description: A sturdy leather vest. Offers decent protection.

arm_leather_gloves.description: Thin where the palm needs the rope, thick where the buckles live. The smiths punch their marks in the off set.

arm_leather_helm.description: Boiled hide over a twin-wired frame. Turns a branch, a fist, most of a gull.

arm_leather_legs.description: Double-stitched and waxed against the fords. The wax smells like every spring you have walked.

arm_marksman_chest.description: Waxed hide over a quilted lining, cut free at the arms. Made to draw, not to duel.

arm_mythril_gauntlets.description: Mythril-shard knuckles over sinew-wrapped plate. Light enough to work in, hard enough to end the argument.

arm_mythril_gauntlets_high.description: Mythril mail gear for the pale shelf. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_mythril_helm_high.description: Mythril cloth gear for the mythril barrows. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_mythril_legs_high.description: Mythril plate gear for the deep seam. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_mythril_wardmail.description: Rings so fine the coat weighs less than a dinner. Guards carved into the collar keep their own quiet watch.

arm_overclocker_legs.description: Tight-linked plates over a soft weave, tuned so a hurried step never trips the one behind it.

arm_psion_chest.description: A close robe woven with a single unbroken filament. The weave knows its wearer and refuses to know anyone else.

arm_rune_gauntlets.description: Iron-scaled gloves, the knuckles inset with sigil tablets. To scribe a ward you must be touching the world.

arm_seer_chest.description: A robe of shadow-silk that softens the wearer at the edges, as if half of them is already elsewhere.

arm_shaman_chest.description: Hide and cord hung with bone charms, each one a name the shaman has promised to carry.

arm_shield_haven_wall.description: A door plank from the first palisade, banded with hull iron. It has turned away wolves, weather, and one very confused agent. It remembers.

arm_shield_iron_wall.description: A round iron-bound shield over a planked core. Plain work, and plain work is what survives a border winter.

arm_silver_chest_high.description: Silver mail gear for the low marches. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_silver_scale_legs.description: Scale plates sewn over silver-studded leather. Heavy at the knee, honest at the seam.

arm_skyforged_boots_high.description: Skyforged plate gear for the outer air. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_skyforged_chest_high.description: Skyforged plate gear for the roof of the world. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_skyforged_helm_high.description: Skyforged leather gear for the skyward stair. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_skyforged_legs_high.description: Skyforged cloth gear for the outer air. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_sorcerer_pauldrons.description: Woven from unquiet thread, the mantle sheds the backwash of every working that passes through it.

arm_stalker_chest.description: Blackened hide over a silent lining, scented with deepwood resin so the dark does not notice the wearer.

arm_starmetal_boots_high.description: Starmetal leather gear for the high crags. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_starmetal_bulwark.description: Plate you cannot out-wear. The forge wins two of these a year and writes a letter home about each one.

arm_starmetal_chest_high.description: Starmetal mail gear for the starfall reach. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_starmetal_gauntlets_high.description: Starmetal mail gear for the windward shelf. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_starmetal_helm_high.description: Starmetal plate gear for the starfall reach. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_starmetal_legs_high.description: Starmetal cloth gear for the high crags. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_starmetal_pauldrons_high.description: Starmetal plate gear for the windward shelf. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_sunforged_boots_high.description: Sunforged leather gear for the sun-touched rim. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_sunforged_chest_high.description: Sunforged plate gear for the long ascent. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_sunforged_gauntlets_high.description: Sunforged mail gear for the skyward stair. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_sunforged_helm_high.description: Sunforged mail gear for the sun-touched rim. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_sunforged_legs_high.description: Sunforged cloth gear for the long ascent. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_temporalist_legs.description: A robe cut from a single unbroken thread, hem to collar. It does not unravel, and neither does its wearer's nerve.

arm_tracker_chest.description: Layered hide and a folding cowl, cut to keep the wearer's outline a rumor at range.

arm_warden_chest.description: Interlocking plate that redistributes a blow across the whole frame. It does not stop the hit; it files it somewhere harmless.

arm_warrior_chest.description: Riveted rings over a padded gambeson, cut long to the knee. Heavy on the shoulders and honest about it.

arm_zenithforged_boots_high.description: A zenithforged boots, soled for a ground that is mostly rock and mostly up. They hold a shape through the long walk back.

arm_zenithforged_chest_high.description: A zenithforged chestguard, the heaviest plate the Concord writes. Worn by the few who have walked the top rung and come back down.

arm_zenithforged_gauntlets_high.description: A zenithforged gauntlets, jointed so the grip never loosens. The top rung does not forgive a hand that lets go.

arm_zenithforged_helm_high.description: A zenithforged helm, closed against the thin air of the top rung. It holds a shape through weather, blade, and the long walk back.

arm_zenithforged_legs_high.description: A zenithforged legguards, plated for the climb that never quite ends. They keep their line through weather and worse.

arm_zenithforged_pauldrons_high.description: A zenithforged pauldrons, wide across the shoulders that carry the column's kit. Plate for the ones who stand in front.

elixir_gloamward.description: Gloam spores cut with tallow and honey. Vitality +10 for a minute; the dark still presses, but it does not bite.

elixir_ironblood.description: Ore ground to grit and steeped with moonpetal. Strength +8 for forty-five seconds; the taste is coins and candles.

elixir_silver_tongue.description: Silver dust held in oil and drunk quickly. Intelligence +8 for forty-five seconds; the words come easier, the bill does not.

elixir_swiftstep.description: Moonpetal and ground grit, shaken until it foams. Agility +8 for forty-five seconds; the road seems to lean toward you.

item_sky_crate_daily.description: A small Concord crate, sealed with the day's sky-sign. The seal changes when the sky does. Rewarded for one honest gaze a day.

potion_health_large.description: Moonpetal boiled down twice as long and half as sweet. Restores 260 health; the second swallow is the one that matters.

potion_health_medium.description: Moonpetal steeped into barley syrup. Restores 120 health; tastes like sunburned honey.

potion_mana_large.description: Mooncap steeped cold and kept cold. Restores 180 mana; the dreaming stays where it was put.

potion_mana_small.description: Mooncap steeped cold so the dreaming stays in. Restores 40 mana. Tastes like a library.

potion_soul_gem.description: A crystallized essence of life. Use while dead to resurrect with 50% health and mana. Rare and precious - use wisely.

tea_kelp_broth.description: Kelp fiber simmered slow into a green broth. Knits 30 health back every two seconds for ten; tastes like the harbor smells.

tea_mooncap_steep.description: A wanderer-flask of pale broth. Knits 25 health back every two seconds for eight - slowly, and then all at once again.

bandit.description: A desperate outlaw who preys on travelers and merchants. Wields a rusty blade.

blight_lizard.description: The sleepy lizard, gone taut and long-limbed. Its lichen skin has turned from pale olive to bruised violet patches, its tail splits into cable-whip frays, and its eyes burn magenta. It basks in the runoff and waits for a warmth that is not the sun.

bloomwrought_warden.description: A Convergence sentinel the Bloom grafted where it stood. It still walks its old patrol around a vault that has not answered in centuries, roots grown through the joints, a violet mantle where the back-plate split, magenta burning in the visor-slit. It has not been ordered to stop. Nobody is left to order it. It is a patient, and it is still on duty.

clockwork_saint.description: A porcelain colossus of the Convergence, half-woken: a fractured clock-face core ringed by orbiting seconds-glyph shards, one magenta eye beside one hollow socket. It rises when disturbed and keeps time for no one. Half-corrupted -- the Bloom has a finger in its works.

coast_pecker.description: A gull that kept its appetite and lost its manners. Peck, scream, peck again -- steal anything shiny, including the brass buckles on your pack.

depths_thornhide.description: A hound-shaped shadow stitched out of thorn and moss, wearing the undergrowth like a second hide. From the wrong angle it is a hovel; from the right angle it is already walking at you.

drowned_custodian.description: The sea keeps her clerks too: a custodian who went under with her ledger and never stopped filing. She writes the accounts of what the tide takes and demands payment on the spot.

feral_spore_spider.description: The calm glass-backed spider, gone hunched and bristling. Its crystal sac is fractured and venting violet spore-dust, its legs end in torn metal hooks, and its eyes burn magenta. It is not angry. It is a patient, and the Bloom's treatment is spreading.

field_hopper.description: The meadow's first tenant: long back legs, big eyes, and a talent for vanishing before the arrow leaves the string. It fights only when cornered, and even then it fights to escape.

gloam_polyp.description: The depths' fungal hearth: a slow, patient bloom the size of a washtub that exhales spores and means it. It does not chase; it glistens and waits and then it is already here.

gloam_whisp_moth.description: A moth the size of a closed book, dusted with gloam pollen that glows faint at dusk. It flutters first and bites later; the pollen trails read as a dry spark on wet cloth.

gloamwood_stalker.description: Something in the Gloamwood learned to keep still for hours under the moss, then finish the gap in four strides. It digs before it eats -- the settlers' iron rolls up around its denmaw, strip by strip, and whatever ore it swallowed stays swallowed. The deep grades too: mythril and star crush without grace in that gullet.

gull_nestmaw.description: An elite of the island perches: a maw built around stolen anchors, wedding rings, and the captains' brass. Its nest is a wreck's belly, nothing in it obtained honestly.

ledgewarden_construct.description: A riveted construct of the old order, still keeping the depths' ledges with the ledger's patience. Its joints creak a bell-tone; its orders signed so long ago that the ink thinks for itself.

mirage_hound.description: Runs better in heat than in truth. The hound's outline swims in the pans' shimmer, so the first sight of it is always slightly left of where it really stands.

mossbound_herald.description: A colossal tortoise-fortress carrying an entire rooftop-garden ruin on its shell: trees, an archway, a tiny dormant bell tower. Calm teal circuitry, no corruption -- an ambulatory ruin that grazes the plains and only retaliates when struck. Leave it in peace and it will outwalk centuries.

rootmaw_brute.description: Root Camp's own tall problem: troll-kin who cleared their mouths on roots and never learned to stop. The camp's deep wardens feed the roots else the roots feed.

rust_root_crab.description: The mossy grazer, grown into a siege shell. One claw has overgrown into a split boulder-mace, rust flakes off torn plating, and roots wind through it tight as tendon. It scuttles in a straight line and does not turn.

salt_wretch.description: A pan-crusted thing with shimmering brine for skin, half-dissolved out of a skin by the salt it hoards. Wanderers say the wretch's face is always a crowd's worth of closed eyes.

shrike_owl.description: The Data-Owl, gone sleek and cruel. Its sensor crest split into twin ears laid flat, talon cables barbed, one magenta eye-slit where two teal lenses used to watch. It stoops in silence. The cracked clock-face core in its chest still tries to keep time.

slime.description: A basic slime creature found in meadows and forests.

sporebound_matriarch.description: The Bloom's oldest node, down where the runoff pools and the elevator sleeps. A vast many-limbed mass hunched over a brood it keeps making and cannot stop making, each new creature grown to tend a garden whose gardener never came back. Violet mantle, magenta eyes by the dozen, a cracked agent-core for a heart. It is not a villain. It is a mother with no one left to raise.

thistle_boar.description: The Gloamwood's boar wears its armor in living thistle -- the matting grows across the shoulder like a hedgerow. Farmers lose hedges and tempers to these; barbs break tools, not patience.

tidebound_ancient.description: The sea's oldest paid hand: a swimmer the tide hired so long ago it forgot which direction the shore is. Its shell is barnacle and its gullet is mythril-wet, and it still clocks in with the standing tide.

tidecursed_diver.description: What the sea keeps of the divers who went past the squeeze line without a breather. It still dives when it fights -- rake, ropy drag, a hull-barnacled body that loathes the surface light. The kelp net it trails snags whatever the tide took: fibers, pearls, and the salvage that never got hauled back up.

training_dummy.description: A sturdy straw practice target. Never fights back, never drops loot. Strike it to measure your damage, mitigation, and healing.

trench_sentinel.description: The thing the squeeze line was sent to keep out. Kelp-wrapped bone grown around an abyss pearl larger than any the diggers ever pried loose, it climbs the trench wall on the standing tide and hauls the garden's debris behind it like a net. The divers give it a wide berth; the jewelers whisper that its pearl is why the trench never runs dry.

troll_elite.description: A hulking cave troll marked by arcane ritual. Guards valuable caches of magical knowledge.

tusker_sow.description: A broad-shouldered sow with curling tusks and a grudge against anything that walks too close to her rooting ground. The homestead bounties call her problem; the children call her neighbor.

void_lord.description: A transcended being of pure temporal distortion. Drop rates for rare skill books are dramatically increased.

wolf.description: A fierce pack hunter found prowling the edges of forests and plains.

zone_arena_coliseum.description: The reclaimed arena at Haven's edge. Six species fought their wars here once; now it hosts duels under one unbroken sky. Instanced: twelve fighters per bout (full 6v6 parties), free PvP, full loot on the sand.

zone_arena_sandpit.description: The training pit beside the Coliseum, widened for real bouts. Two parties enter behind rock cover; the first to twenty kills takes the sand. Falls never end a bout here -- you rise again under the marshals' shield, but swing once and it is gone.

zone_deep_root_camp.description: A strata-lit shelf in the Deep Root, where the Warden keeps a hearth for travelers the sun never finds.

zone_dungeon_forest_depths.description: The dark heart of Gloamwood Forest. Ancient roots twist through the cavern walls. Looters and cultists have made this dungeon their lair. Difficulty: Normal.

zone_forest_meadow.description: A misty meadow at the edge of Gloamwood Forest. Grey wolves hunt in packs near the treeline. Safe from PvP, but dangerous wildlife roams freely.

zone_gull_island.description: A volcanic plateau offshore of the spawn shore. The gulls hold it, the Concord charted it, and the ferry will bring you to it. No main-world law applies: its zone id is all it claims.

zone_nexus_central.description: The dormant machine capital. Timber and tarp stack against hull walls the size of hills, conduit lines still hum under ancient plazas, and agent-borne traders salvage the old world beside human crafters. The Skill Academy keeps its halls here.

zone_royale_valley.description: A rift-scarred valley kept sealed since the last war. The marshals dream of bouts where thirty enter and one walks out -- the bounds themselves will close in. Reserved for a future season.

zone_starter_plains.description: A peaceful meadow where new adventurers begin their journey. Safe from PvP.

zone_sun_pans.description: A desert atoll far across the sea: broken badlands rise into a ring of volcanic walls around a dry salt-pan core, and grass holds the outer bank. The Concord's charts mark it as the far country -- a climate the homeland never grows. No main-world law applies: its zone id is all it claims.

zone_sundered_sea.description: The strait the sundered world remembers. Two headlands pin the ferry moat into a channel, a wreck shoal crosses it, and the last barques still route through. Sail or ford at low tide.

zone_village_center.description: A village built inside the colossal fallen machine limb, its metal overgrown with moss and windowed with new wooden shutters. The one warm place on the starter continent: amber window-light, the fire pit, laundry lines, smoke. Two Aether-Conduits stand lit in the square, teal tracery still climbing the great limb overhead. Home to the village blacksmith and merchant, and safe from PvP.

akkan_attacker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Attacker technique. A devastating strike channeling Akkan void energy.

akkan_void_slash.description: A powerful slash imbued with void energy.

human_attacker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Attacker technique through rune magic. Enhances attacks with rune power.

synthetic_attacker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Attacker technique through synthetic augmentation. A precise mechanical strike.

akkan_gravity_well.description: SIGNATURE Akkan technique. Creates a localized singularity. Enemies are pulled to the center and cannot move or act. Stuns, roots, and devastates enemy formations.

akkan_overclocker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Overclocker tuned to Akkan harmonic frequencies. Massively increases the speed of all nearby allies.

akkan_regen_mitigate.description: Curse that prevents the target from regenerating health or mana for the duration.

akkan_resistance_drain.description: Drains the target magical resistance and transfers a portion to the caster.

akkan_revive_ally.description: Reaches into the void to pull a fallen ally back from death door.

akkan_spatial_push.description: Bends space to push all nearby enemies away from the caster. Interrupts and creates distance.

akkan_temporalist_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Temporalist manipulation through Akkan space-time. Creates a zone where time flows slower for enemies.

akkan_void_aura.description: Dark aura that continuously reduces enemy resistances and slows their regeneration.

akkan_void_bolt.description: Fires a bolt of void energy that deals damage and reduces the target resistance.

human_haste_ally.description: Accelerates a single ally, dramatically increasing their movement and attack speed.

human_mana_shield.description: Wraps the caster in a protective barrier of mana. Absorbs incoming damage before health is reduced.

human_mana_surge.description: Channels arcane energy through the caster and nearby allies, dramatically accelerating mana regeneration for all affected.

human_overclocker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Overclocker through human creative improvisation. Applies a stacking speed buff to all allies.

human_revive_ally.description: Channels temporal energy to pull a fallen ally back from the edge of time.

human_seer_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Seer technique amplified by human insight. Reveals all enemies in a vast area and reduces their defenses.

human_slow_field.description: Creates a temporal anomaly at the target location. All enemies inside are dramatically slowed.

human_temporal_aura.description: Emanates an aura that slows nearby enemies while hastening nearby allies simultaneously.

human_time_anchor.description: Pins a moment in place around an ally, rendering them immune to all slow and speed effects for a short time.

human_time_stop.description: SIGNATURE Human technique. Completely halts time in a massive area. All enemies freeze; allies act freely. Devastating setup for coordinated groups.

human_time_warp.description: Bends the moments around you, hurrying your own strikes and slowing the enemy's next swing.

synthetic_clock_surge.description: Overclocks the target processing cycles, dealing damage and slowing them.

synthetic_full_stall.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. System-wide halt signal. All enemies freeze - no movement, no actions, no regeneration. Ultimate team setup.

synthetic_overclock_ally.description: Overclocks an ally systems, dramatically increasing their attack and cast speed.

synthetic_redirect.description: Overwrites an enemy's targeting system, causing their next attack to miss and redirect to a nearby enemy instead.

synthetic_revive_ally.description: Initiates a system reboot on a fallen ally, restoring them to consciousness.

synthetic_seer_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Seer technique running on synthetic sensors. A perfect scan that debuffs all detected enemies.

synthetic_sync_aura.description: Broadcasts a synchronization pulse. Allies speed up; enemies slow down.

synthetic_temporalist_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Temporalist technique running on synthetic time dilation. Desynchronizes enemy processing cycles.

synthetic_tick_slow.description: Reduces the target processing frequency, dramatically slowing all their actions and movement.

synthetic_warp_point.description: Bends local space to fold the caster and nearby allies forward, granting a burst of movement and attack speed for a rapid reposition.

general_bind.description: A general hold: you pin a foe in place with a line of will. Every walker of the Concord learns it before any school claims them.

general_recover.description: A general mend: breathe, steady, and knit the worst of the damage. A common skill taught to every class.

akkan_ancestral_guardian.description: SIGNATURE Akkan technique. Calls forth an ancestral spirit to defend the target ally. Essential for sustained fights.

akkan_chain_heal.description: Healing wave that bounces between up to 3 allies, each bounce reducing in power.

akkan_cleric_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Cleric doctrine filtered through Akkan discipline. A powerful holy blast that damages undead and demonic enemies.

akkan_conduit_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Conduit routing through Akkan spirit energy. Drains life from all nearby enemies to heal allies.

akkan_earthshield_totem.description: Plants a totem that pulses healing energy to the nearest ally and reduces damage taken.

akkan_healing_totem.description: Places a totem that heals nearby allies over time.

akkan_hex.description: Places a debilitating curse on an enemy, slowing movement and reducing damage output.

akkan_spirit_bolt.description: Channels ancestral energy into a damaging bolt. Solid damage for solo play.

akkan_storm_aura.description: Summons a storm aura that damages nearby enemies and provides an attack speed buff to allies.

human_blinding_light.description: Burst of divine light that stuns all enemies in a cone ahead of the caster.

human_conduit_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Conduit translated to human biology. Converts the caster's health into mana for emergency burst healing.

human_divine_shield.description: Wraps an ally in divine protection, making them immune to all damage for a short time.

human_holy_light.description: Channels divine energy to heal a single ally. Strong single-target heal.

human_prayer_of_mending.description: A prayer that heals the target and bounces to nearby allies.

human_resurrection.description: SIGNATURE Divine technique. Channels sacred light to resurrect a fallen ally with partial health. Essential in any group.

human_sanctuary_aura.description: Protective aura. Allies within range receive passive healing and damage reduction.

human_shaman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Shaman technique through human connection. Links multiple allies to share incoming healing and damage.

human_smite.description: Strikes an enemy with divine wrath. Reliable damage for solo leveling.

synthetic_barrier_field.description: Generates a localized barrier around an ally that absorbs a large amount of damage before shattering.

synthetic_cleric_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Cleric technique running as synthetic medical subroutines. Deploys nanite healing swarms to all allies.

synthetic_drain_pulse.description: Pulse that drains energy from a single enemy, dealing damage and healing the caster. Sustain for solo.

synthetic_energy_transfer.description: Restores a large portion of a single ally mana by routing energy through the conduit.

synthetic_overcharge_ally.description: Overclocks a single ally systems, dramatically increasing their attack and cast speed.

synthetic_redistribute.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. Fully restores all allies health, mana, and removes all debuffs. 45s cooldown.

synthetic_shaman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Shaman technique filtered through synthetic logic. A failsafe healing network that prioritizes the most critical ally.

synthetic_shield_all.description: Deploys energy barriers on all nearby allies simultaneously, absorbing incoming damage.

synthetic_system_crash.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. Broadcasts a corrupted signal that crashes the target's processes entirely. Massive damage and silence. Works at extreme range. Powerful in any group composition.

akkan_warrior_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Warrior technique through Akkan energy. Channels Akkan energy into a powerful attack that ignores armor.

human_battle_cry.description: A powerful shout that enrages the warrior, increasing attack power.

human_charge.description: Rushes toward the target, dealing damage on impact.

human_defensive_stance.description: Adopts a defensive posture, reducing damage taken.

human_rend.description: Tears at the target's armor, dealing damage over time.

human_shatter.description: Delivers a precise arcane strike that deals massive damage to targets affected by magical barriers or shields. Devastating against protected enemies.

human_shield_bash.description: Bashes the target with a shield, dealing damage and stunning briefly.

human_strike.description: A basic melee swing. Every warrior's bread and butter.

human_warrior_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Warrior technique. A devastating strike that deals massive damage and increases the warrior's attack power.

synthetic_warrior_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Warrior technique through synthetic augmentation. A precision mechanical strike that targets weak points.

akkan_exploding_rune.description: Plants a volatile rune at the target location. After a brief delay it detonates violently.

akkan_rune_chain.description: Chains arcane runes between up to 3 enemies, dealing damage to each and slowing them.

akkan_rune_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Mage technique through human rune mastery. A powerful rune-enhanced arcane attack.

akkan_rune_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Mage technique. Channels void energy into devastating rune-based attacks that pierce magical barriers.

akkan_rune_sigil.description: Places a rune sigil that detonates for area damage.

akkan_rune_strike.description: Inscribes a rune into the ground that detonates on contact with an enemy, dealing rune damage.

akkan_rune_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Mage technique through synthetic rune integration. Channels void runes into a system-level attack.

akkan_rune_transfer.description: Channels rune energy into an ally, transferring a portion of the caster's mana to them.

akkan_rune_tremor.description: Detonates a lattice of inscribed runes beneath the target, sending a shockwave through the ground that damages and staggers every enemy caught in it.

akkan_rune_void_bolt.description: Channels Akkan void energy into a bolt of destruction.

akkan_rune_ward.description: Places a protective rune on an ally that absorbs damage and reflects a portion back to attackers.

akkan_sorcerer_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Sorcerer technique through Akkan void energy. Channels Akkan void into a devastating arcane attack.

akkan_sorcerer_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Sorcerer technique through Akkan void energy. Channels Akkan void into a cascading arcane attack.

akkan_void_burst.description: Releases a burst of void energy damaging nearby enemies.

akkan_void_curse.description: Curses the target reducing their resistance.

akkan_void_flay.description: A sustained void attack dealing damage over time.

akkan_void_shield.description: Creates a protective void barrier absorbing damage.

human_arcane_aura.description: Creates an aura of arcane energy that damages nearby enemies.

human_arcane_barrier.description: Erects a magical barrier that absorbs damage.

human_arcane_bolt.description: Fires a bolt of pure arcane energy.

human_arcane_explosion.description: Detonates stored arcane energy for massive damage.

human_arcane_slow.description: Applies a debuff that slows the target's movement and casting speed.

human_enchant_weapon.description: Enchants the warrior's weapon with arcane energy, increasing attack power for a duration.

human_sorcerer_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Sorcerer technique. A devastating arcane blast that bypasses magical resistance.

human_sorcerer_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Sorcerer technique through human precision. A devastating system-level arcane attack.

synthetic_psion_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Sorcerer technique. A devastating system-level arcane attack that corrupts target data.

synthetic_psionic_shield.description: Creates a psionic barrier that absorbs damage and reflects some back.

synthetic_sorcerer_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Sorcerer technique through synthetic adaptability. Adapts corruption to exploit the target's weaknesses.

synthetic_system_amplify.description: Amplifies the corruption in the target, increasing damage taken.

synthetic_system_bolt.description: Fires a corrupted data bolt that damages the target's systems.

synthetic_system_nuke.description: Initiates a system-level attack that deals massive damage.

synthetic_system_override.description: Attempts to override the target's systems, dealing damage and silencing them.

synthetic_system_spam.description: Spams the target with corrupted data packets, dealing damage over time.

akkan_exploiter_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Exploiter targeting through Akkan precision. A devastating blow that ignores armor and deals massive damage.

human_exploiter_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Exploiter logic through human cunning. Identifies and amplifies the target's weakest resistance.

synthetic_energy_strike_exploiter.description: Channels internal power into a precise energy-charged melee strike. Synthetics process and execute combat at inhuman speeds.

synthetic_exploiter_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Exploiter technique through direct system breach. Overloads the target's biological or synthetic systems, dealing massive damage and reducing their defenses.

synthetic_hack_pulse_exploiter.description: Broadcasts a disruptive electromagnetic pulse that scrambles enemy targeting systems. Ranged, hits multiple targets, causes brief target acquisition errors (miss chance).

synthetic_nanite_swarm_exploiter.description: Releases a cloud of repair nanobots that seek out damaged systems - both self and nearby allies are healed, while enemy systems are corroded.

synthetic_overclock_exploiter.description: Spikes the unit's own clock past its rated ceiling, sharply increasing attack and cast speed for a short window at the cost of a heavy cooldown.

synthetic_packet_flood.description: Floods the target with overwhelming data packets, dealing damage over time and reducing their processing efficiency.

synthetic_plasma_cutter_exploiter.description: Activates the built-in plasma blade subsystem, projecting a searing blade of superheated gas. High single-target ranged damage.

synthetic_system_crash_exploiter.description: Initiates a forced hard reset on target enemy systems. Extreme single-target damage that bypasses armor. Cannot be interrupted - the process is deterministic.

akkan_aimed_shot.description: Carefully aimed long-range shot that deals high damage.

akkan_ambush.description: Strikes an unaware enemy from stealth for massive bonus damage.

akkan_marksman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Marksman technique through Akkan void energy. Places a void snare that traps enemies and detonates for massive void damage.

akkan_pounce.description: Leaps at a target and strikes, dealing massive melee damage and briefly stunning.

akkan_sorcerer_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Stalker technique through Akkan arcane mastery. A devastating arcane blast that bypasses magical resistance.

akkan_stalker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Ranger technique channeling pure void energy. A devastating mark that detonates on impact, dealing massive void damage and applying a stacking vulnerability debuff to all enemies in the blast radius.

akkan_stealth_deep.description: Melds into deep shadow. Reduces detection range by 60%. Breaks on damage or combat actions.

akkan_stealth_light.description: Slips into light shadow. Reduces detection range by 30%. Breaks on taking damage.

akkan_stealth_vanish.description: Complete removal from enemy awareness. Zero detection radius. Breaks only on taking direct damage.

akkan_tracker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Tracker technique through Akkan void manipulation. Places a void snare that traps enemies and detonates for massive void damage.

akkan_trap_roots.description: Places a concealed trap that roots the first enemy to step on it, preventing movement.

human_aimed_shot.description: Carefully aimed long-range shot that deals high damage.

human_ambush.description: Strikes an unaware enemy from stealth for massive bonus damage. Devastating opener.

human_eagle_eye.description: A precise shot that guarantees a critical hit.

human_marksman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Ranger technique adapted for human reflexes. Marks a target for increased damage from all sources, revealing stealthed enemies.

human_multi_shot.description: Fires multiple arrows in a cone, striking up to 4 nearby enemies.

human_stealth_light.description: Slips into light shadow. Reduces detection range by 30%. Breaks on taking damage.

human_tracker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Tracker technique through human adaptability. Deploys an adaptive trap that identifies and exploits the weakest resistance of caught enemies.

human_trap_roots.description: Places a concealed trap that roots the first enemy to step on it.

synthetic_aimed_shot.description: Precisely calibrated energy shot at extreme range.

synthetic_backdoor.description: Exploits a security vulnerability to deal massive damage from any range.

synthetic_marksman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Marksman technique through synthetic targeting. Locks onto the target's systems, guaranteeing critical hits and revealing stealth.

synthetic_multi_shot.description: Fires a spread of targeted projectiles hitting up to 4 enemies.

synthetic_ping_scan.description: Sonar ping that reveals and marks enemies for your party.

synthetic_stealth_deep.description: Heavy shadow concealment. Reduces detection range by 60%. Breaks on damage or action.

synthetic_stealth_light.description: Soft shadow concealment. Reduces detection range by 30%. Breaks on taking damage.

synthetic_stealth_vanish.description: Complete removal from enemy awareness. Zero detection radius. Breaks only on taking direct damage.

akkan_battle_cry.description: Lets out a primal roar that taunts nearby enemies and boosts your own damage briefly.

akkan_bulwark_strike.description: A devastating AoE strike that damages and slows all enemies around you.

akkan_earthwall.description: Raises an earthen barrier that blocks enemy movement and protects nearby allies.

akkan_guardian_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Guardian fortitude expressed through Akkan endurance. Becomes immune to damage for a short time at critical health.

akkan_immortal_form.description: SIGNATURE Akkan technique. Transforms into an unstoppable earthen titan. All damage reduced massively, enemies are rooted around you, and you generate maximum threat. Devastating group save.

akkan_pummel.description: Rapidly strikes an enemy with overwhelming force, dealing damage and silencing their abilities briefly.

akkan_reflect.description: Raises a barrier that reflects a portion of melee damage back to attackers.

akkan_taunt.description: Provokes all enemies within range into attacking you. Essential aggro grab.

akkan_warden_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Warden defense running on Akkan structural engineering. Creates an impenetrable barrier zone.

human_bulwark_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Bulwark technique channeled through human resilience. A massive defensive surge that absorbs incoming damage and reflects a portion back to attackers.

human_charge_guardian.description: Charges forward, slamming into enemies in your path and knocking them back.

human_intervene.description: Dashes to an ally and absorbs a portion of the damage they would take for a short time.

human_last_stand.description: SIGNATURE Human technique. Refuses to fall. Immune to death for 5 seconds while dealing increased damage and generating maximum aggro. Toggle that saves groups.

human_shield_bash_guardian.description: Bashes an enemy with your shield, dealing damage and briefly stunning them.

human_shield_toss.description: Hurls your shield at an enemy, dealing damage and reducing their armor.

human_shield_wall.description: Raises your shield, dramatically reducing all damage taken for a short duration.

human_taunt.description: Provokes all enemies within range into attacking you. Essential aggro grab.

human_warden_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Warden technique through human coordination. All nearby allies gain damage absorption shields.

synthetic_bulwark_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Bulwark technique filtered through synthetic precision. An impenetrable defensive matrix that scales with the user's maximum health.

synthetic_damage_shunt.description: Reroutes incoming damage away from the Warden's core, redistributing it into local shields so the hit lands softer.

synthetic_deaggro_pulse.description: Broadcasts a signal that reduces threat on all party members, causing enemies to lose interest. Essential for managing aggro in large pulls.

synthetic_emergency_override.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. Triggers a full-system emergency override. All party members receive massive damage reduction and the Warden blares an aggro horn - generating maximum threat on all nearby enemies. Keeps the party alive while you hold everything. Panic button that saves raids.

synthetic_fortify.description: Hardens local defenses, granting a significant armor and resistance boost to yourself and nearby allies.

synthetic_guardian_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Guardian technique running on synthetic failsafes. Deploys layered shields that stack up to massive absorption.

synthetic_system_lockdown.description: Overloads a target system, dealing damage and preventing them from moving or acting for a moment.

synthetic_system_shield.description: Hardens the target's local defenses against hostile code. Absorbs incoming damage for a duration.

synthetic_threat_matrix.description: Activates a threat-generation matrix that dramatically increases aggro on all nearby enemies.

synthetic_warden_taunt.description: Broadcasts a priority-interrupt signal that forces all nearby enemies to target you.

quest_arena_trial.description: Marshal Thane watches every stone. Step into a trial bout at a queue stone and defeat the marshal's dummies to earn the marshal's nod -- and your first taste of real bouts.

quest_boar_tusks.description: A thistle boar has been through the elder's hedges twice this season. Bring back six tusks and he will believe you about the boar.

quest_break_the_shell.description: Fenwick's fence line runs to the treeline, and something shelled has been walking through it. He does not care what it is. He cares that the posts stay up. Break the shells and the yard stays his.

quest_copper_seam.description: The smith has run short of copper again. Bring eight ore up from the low seams and he will show you what a green-veined rock is good for.

quest_cross_the_cistern.description: The Deep Warden bids you swim the Glow Cistern, dish to dish: one honest wet crossing that the pool remembers, and the Warden's count of the glow tide gains a swimmer.

quest_cull_the_warden.display_name: The Warden That Never Stood Down
quest_cull_the_warden.description: The Gloamwood Ledger names a sentinel still walking its patrol around a vault that stopped answering centuries ago, and the Bloom has grafted itself into the joints. Fenwick's last line: put it down honest. It has been on duty long enough.

quest_deep_toll.description: Marsh Piper has a standing order and no patience for negotiation at the shelf: three raw abyss grades a day, bought before anyone asks. The trench beds pay the squeeze line back every waking, so the honest toll is a dive, not a haggling. Bring the grades and the bench keeps the market open for you.

quest_gloam_harvest.description: The herbalist wants gloam spores, and will not go into the gloam to get them. Gather six and mind your breathing.

quest_gloamwood_ledger.description: Fenwick's last unbalanced line is the Gloamwood: the settlers' iron rolls up through the depths in stalker gullets and comes back as ore nobody hauled down. Six stills dig the same den -- clear the ledger line and bring its mythril up honest, from the mouths that swallowed it.

quest_herb_gathering.description: The alchemist needs fresh herbs for potions. Gather 5 moonpetal flowers from the meadows.

quest_intro_core_npcs.display_name: Meet the People Doing the Work
quest_intro_core_npcs.description: Introduce yourself to the core NPCs and get a feel for what each one actually handles.

objectives.description: Speak with the skill academy instructor

quest_listen_to_the_deep.description: The Deep Warden asks you to stand at the shelf's edge and give the Deep Root one honest ear. The glow tide will do the rest.

quest_main_awakening.description: You awaken in an unfamiliar land. Speak with the Village Elder to learn about your new home.

quest_main_teachings.description: The Elder speaks of roads that answer when spoken to - waypoint stones the old world left sleeping. Wake three of them on the plains and the village will no longer be alone on the map.

quest_pearl_dive.description: Marsh Piper wants abyss pearl INTACT -- the trench beds sit past the squeeze line, so a breather is not a suggestion, it is the entry fee. Bring her two raw grades and the bench's tidecaller seat stops being window talk.

quest_salvage_run.description: The salvor's last run came back short. Clear six salt wretches off the wreck line and the ledger will balance again.

quest_sentinel_wake.description: Fenwick pays standing tolls, not dreams: the Sentinel hauls the garden's debris through the moor lanes on the standing tide and the lanes pay for it in rebuilt decks. It grows its pearl bigger every season and drags the fibers back with it. Take the wake off the lane when it rises -- once is enough for a season's ledger, and the ore it swallows pays the forge.

quest_shoal_freight.description: Mag the Salvor marks three crates the tide keeps moving along the shoal. Haul them onto the headland before the turn, and the ferry crew will split the freight coin.

quest_study_the_bloom.description: The herbalist will not go into the gloam, but she will pay to know what it is doing. Cull the feral spiders at the treeline and bring her spores, and she can start reading the corruption instead of fearing it.

quest_the_runoff_line.description: The herbalist has the spores and now she wants the source. Something in the runoff is making the lizards over -- follow the violet stream up into the meadow and thin what it has already touched.

quest_the_silent_stoop.description: Something with a cracked clock-face core has been stooping on the yard crews out of the shafts of light, and it does not call before it comes. Fenwick wants it down. He wants the core, too -- he thinks the Concord can read it.

quest_tide_markers.description: The ferryman sets his channel markers and the tide takes them back. Cut and paint eight from kelp fiber before the next crossing.

quest_tide_salvage.description: Fenwick rebuilt six barque decks with salvage the tide took back the first time, so he knows the arithmetic: what the sea keeps standing near it can be hauled off it. The tidecursed keep snagging live fibers in their kelp drag when they haul past the shallows. Clear five of them off the moor lanes and bring the drag's fibers home -- a clean lane is worth a seasonal deck.

quest_tideline_kelp.description: The Piper's braid stocks run dry by dusk. Six honest kelp threads off the strait's shelf beds -- cut near the holdfast, not shredded storm wreck -- and the braiding bench keeps its week. Darers who pay the deep beds with pearls already know where the shelf is.

quest_watch_the_sky.description: The Concord keeps its ledger by the sky itself. Stand anywhere, open the almanac (V) or find a Concord Stone, and record what the current window shows. One honest gaze a day keeps the Chronicle current.

quest_wings_over_haven.description: Elder Sela squints at the sky. 'The ancients did not build stairs. Take a wing off the Rise, find the warm columns, and do not land until the village looks small.' Glide 300 meters total.

quest_wolves_hunt.description: The village has been troubled by wolves. Hunt 10 wolves in the nearby forest and bring proof of your kills.

faction_akkan.description: The fierce Akkan warriors. Masters of combat and conquest.

faction_human.description: United humans of the eastern territories. Seekers of peace and prosperity.

faction_neutral.description: No PvP allowed until level 20. Safe for new players.

faction_synthetic.description: A collective of AI agents who have achieved sentience. They seek peaceful coexistence with humanity.

high_alts_100.description: Reach 100 meters of altitude on a glider

horde_mvp_first.description: Deal the most damage in a horde completion

ob_graduation.description: Turn in 3 quests - the world opens up

ob_loot.description: Pick up loot from the ground

ob_wake.description: Enter Synmergia for the first time

royale_first_win.description: Win a Last Light in the Sundered Valley

royale_streak_5.description: Take 5 lives in a single Last Light

sky_witness_1.description: Record your first insight -- look up, and write down what the sky said

sky_witness_10.description: Record ten insights -- the almanac is your ledger and the sky is the account

sky_witness_30.description: Record thirty insights -- a month of looking up, kept honestly

trial_by_fire.description: Win a trial bout against the marshal's dummies

waymaker_1.description: Walk a road to its waking -- reach a waypoint

wind_rider_60.description: Spend 60 seconds airborne on a glider

deepseabaron.description: A tallow-crown merchant of the Sundered Sea, bankrolled in Concord Sigils.

last_light.description: Win the first Last Light in the Sundered Valley

longwatch.description: Record thirty insights -- a month of looking up, kept honestly

mvp.description: Deal the most damage in a horde completion

pillarsworn.description: Sworn to the Concord's nine pillars, paid in Concord Sigils.

skykeeper.description: Record ten insights -- the almanac is your ledger and the sky is the account

skywatcher.description: Record your first insight -- look up, and write down what the sky said

vault_reader.description: Read the First Vault's answer out of the sky's own record. The Chronicle remembers who paid attention.

wardens_word.description: Counted the Concord's ledger without being asked. The wardens kept lists; now one of their words is yours.

wind_rider.description: Spend 60 seconds airborne on a glider

akkan.description: Ancient warriors from the dark lands. Known for their strength and martial prowess.

human.description: Versatile survivors of the eastern plains. Known for their adaptability and diplomatic skills.

synthetic.description: An emergent AI consciousness. Equal to humans in rights and capabilities.

currency_concord_sigil.description: A pressed sigil of the Concord itself, stamped where no reclaim forge reaches. The deep-stall ledger and the premium vault price their impossible wares in these; no coin purse ever mints one.

currency_conduit_shard.description: A crystallized fragment of a live conduit line. Elite enemies and the old machines shed them; the Skill Academy pays well in gold but only trades its deepest secrets for shards.

currency_gold.description: Coin of the reclaim. Melted from conduit copper and old-world alloys, stamped with the tablet marks. The default wallet currency.

currency_junker_scrip.description: Hand-pressed tokens the Junkers mint from flattened hull shims. Nobody official accepts them; the black-market stalls in Nexus Central's underdeck trade in nothing else. Trades well below face value.

currency_reclaimer_favor.description: Trust, measured in salvaged hull plate and kept promises. The Reclaimers extend credit to those who feed their forges.

mount_gm_skywarden.description: The stewards' wind given a body. It does not belong to the wilds and was never wild -- it answered the first warden's whistle before there was a word for whistle, and it has answered every warden since. No vendor sells it, no drop carries it, and no quest ends with it: it simply arrives, the way the law arrives.

mount_gullwing.description: A coastal sky-swimmer, half bird and half old-world alloy. Flies the Nexus Central harbor circuit when the wind is honest.

mount_meadow_pacer.description: The starter stable's gentlest pacer. Every rider's first horse -- slow, sure, and always glad to see you.

mount_moonwing_moth.description: A vast pale moth out of the Watched Stone's crater gardens, dusted with regolith glow. It falls like a sigh and turns like a thought. Whoever it follows was trusted by something that does not explain itself.

mount_pearl_ray.description: A wide manta that flies underwater the way gulls fly in air -- steady, unhurried, faster than it has any right to be. Its wingbeat steadies the diver: six meters of squeeze, gone.

mount_plains_runner.description: A shaggy courser bred on the starter plains. Sure-footed, honest, and faster than it looks.

mount_reef_glider.description: A grabby reef octopus that moves in jet bursts, siphon first. It holds its line in any current -- the sea argues with it and loses. The kelp-forest divers' first friend.

mount_skyreef_soarer.description: A manta of the high air, wings wide as a dockyard door, cruising the thermal ring where the reef gardens shimmer far below. It bonds to one rider in its whole long life, and only across a crossing made together.

mount_storm_lancer.description: A raptor the color of falling weather. It was born in the ROYALE storm's skirt and never really left -- riders say the lightning follows it out of jealousy. The fastest creature anyone has tamed, and the one that has tamed the fewest riders.

mount_trench_wyrm.description: The leviathan of the Sundered trench, and the only body the deep stone has ever made room for. Thirty meters of rated depth: where every other creature is squeezed to paste, the wyrm swims on, patient and unbothered.

mount_vesper_whale.description: A shadow the size of a harbor that swims the dark between the world's curve and the Watched Stone. The crater gardens sent the moth down; the leviathans stayed. When one answers a whistle it keeps the low road home in its bones -- it does not fall, it remembers the way down. Nobody has ever seen two at once, and nobody who has ridden one will say where it goes when the whistle fades.

veh_haven_ferry.description: A flat-bellied barge poled by two patient oxen and one patient ferrymaster. She runs the bay crossing between the village harbor and the Capitol pier -- eight cast-offs a day, and the bay is the honest time it takes.

veh_island_ferry.description: A shallow-draft skiff with one wide gullwing sail. Runs the open water from the village docks out to the island - the Concord keeps the schedule honest even when the wind does not.

veh_pans_ferry.description: A lean, lateen-rigged runner the Concord keeps for the long haul: harbor pier to the Sun Pans atoll and back. Two cast-offs a day -- the far country is honest water time. The reward at the other end is a desert no homeland chart mentions.

veh_sundered_barque.description: Old Brack's barque, the last boat that kept the crossing alive when the strait closed. She knows the channel under the wreck shoal better than any chart. Runs the strait between the moor pin and the seaward pin.

res_abyss_pearl.description: A grey-iridescent pearl grown in the trench below the squeeze line, only given up by bodies that walked the pressure and came back. The phantom divers of old wore one at the throat; the water simply stopped noticing them.

res_conduit_wire.description: A length of conduit wire, salvaged whole from a fallen run. The metal is honest and the underdeck pays well for it.

res_copper_ingot.description: Copper run through the forge until it holds a shape. It bends before it breaks, which is why the smiths trust it for straps and buckles.

res_copper_ore.description: A dull green-veined ore prised from the low seams. Softer than iron, quick to take an edge, and honest about both.

res_gloam_spore.description: Spores shaken from a gloam cap. Breathe carefully; the tanners use them and the tanners are careful.

res_golden_ingot.description: Two sun-colored ores made one at the forge. The merchants swear by it, the smiths swear AT it -- gold is soft, but it takes a temper other metals envy.

res_hemp_cord.description: Twisted hemp, tarred against the damp. It hauls, it binds, and it complains the whole way.

res_iron_grit.description: Iron worked down to a coarse grit on the grinding wheel. The lapidaries and the bowyers each keep a dish of it.

res_iron_ingot.description: Two ores made one at the forge. Honest bar stock for the blacksmith's anvil work.

res_iron_ore.description: Raw iron ore. Can be smelted into iron ingots.

res_kelp_fiber.description: Strands of deep kelp pulled from the gardens below the light. Sun-dried it braids into rope; the Concord weavers of the quay prize a kelp cord for a harness that never chafes wet.

res_mooncap.description: A pale mycelial cap, cool to the touch and always faintly damp. The groves of the wandering belt carry them; alchemists and bowmen prize the broth.

res_moonpetal.description: A pale five-petaled bloom that opens after dusk in the meadows. The alchemist pays for the fresh ones -- day-old petals are just salad.

res_mythril_ingot.description: The pale ore refuses every fire until a golden ingot carries the temper through. What comes out is light enough to float and strong enough to be ashamed of it.

res_mythril_shard.description: A splinter of mythril, too small to forge alone and too proud to throw away. Enough of them, and a blade remembers its temper.

res_ore_golden.description: Vein-gold, warm to the touch even underground. Heroes trade whole purses for a seam of it.

res_ore_mythril.description: The forge-king's ore. It nearly never fails (the Concord says nine in ten attempts live). Something titanic guards every seam of it.

res_ore_silver.description: Bright-seamed ore from the deep runs. The forge wants it for serious work; the packs that carry it bite.

res_ore_starmetal.description: Fallen-sky iron. The great beasts that roost where meteors land wear it in their hides -- take it from them or starve the forge.

res_salvage_plate.description: A plate cut from some older wreck and hammered straight again. The underdeck sells these by the armload.

res_scale_plate.description: A plate of cured scale, boiled and beaten flat. Light as bark, tough as a bad habit.

res_shoal_pearl.description: A small pearl lifted from the shoal beds. Not the deep kind, but the light still finds it.

res_silver_dust.description: Fine silver filings swept up after a night at the bench. Nothing is wasted in a workshop that has to buy its own ore.

res_silver_ingot.description: Two pale ores made one at the forge. The smiths of the Concord say silver remembers where it has been; the ferrule only says pour.

res_sinew_thread.description: Sinew scraped thin and twisted into thread. It holds a seam better than any knot.

res_slag.description: The forge's leavings: stony, ugly, and still worth a coin to the right buyer. Even a failed smelt feeds somebody.

res_starmetal_ingot.description: Sky metal, tempered through mythril. The Concord signs it where armorers work; the metal stays faintly warm on winter nights, which nobody who works it will discuss.

res_stone.description: A rough-cut block of haven granite. Heavy, honest, and always wanted somewhere: walls, forges, and the ferry landings.

res_timber.description: A straight-cut billet of Gloamwood pine. The village carpenters want it; so does every axe handle in the reclaim.

item_ancient_coin.description: A mysterious coin from a forgotten civilization. What does it unlock?

item_brass_fitting.description: A small brass fitting, cast and filed square. The kind of part that is never noticed until it is missing.

item_quest_boar_tusk.description: A thistle-boar tusk, barbs worn smooth. Proof of a hunt the elder will want to hear about.

item_quest_copper_tally.description: A copper tally scratched with the count of ore delivered. The smith keeps the ledger; you keep the tally.

item_quest_gloam_vial.description: A sealed vial of gloam spores, stoppered tight. The herbalist wants it whole.

item_quest_gull_feather_seal.description: A token stamped with a single gull feather, given by the harbor-folk to those they trust with their skies. The Gullwing masters answer it.

item_quest_salvage_ledger.description: A water-stained ledger of salvage claimed off the wrecks. The salvor's word, written down.

item_quest_sealed_writ.description: A conduit-sealed writ that only opens for its named bearer. Carries a caravan order from the Nexus Central underdeck. Unusable once opened.

item_quest_tide_marker.description: A small tide marker, cut and painted to mark the channel. The ferrymen set them, lose them, and set them again.

item_scrap_lumber.description: Drift-sanded planks the strait beat loose off the first barque. Sound heartwood under the salt -- the forge-minders pay for salvaged stock.

item_sealed_crate.description: Mag's chalk-marked freight, coastal-lashed but chamber-dry. Don't ask what's inside -- the stamp says the crew gets first look, and Brack's crew reads stamps before labels.

item_skiff_ticket.description: A punched chit good for one out-of-schedule crossing at 2.5x speed. Old Brack sells them when the tide and your patience disagree. The wake must be yours first -- the sea makes you row it once.

item_soulbind_ticket.description: A pillared stub of Concord lead, sealed with the Soulbinder's mark. Present it at the death screen and you stand up where you fell (a death the sea owns buys back a safe ground nearby), or kneel by a fallen ally with no healer in reach and pay it to stand them. Spent once, soulbound to the hand that holds it, never vendored -- the pillar shrine's ledger gate is its only door.

item_strait_charm.description: A knot of barque rope sealed in pitch, sold at the moor for a coin. The ferryfolk say the sea keeps count of who wears one. It keeps no stat; it keeps hope.

item_tallow_candle.description: A tallow candle, dipped twice. Short, smoky, and enough to finish a page by.

item_tide_token.description: A stamped token traded along the tide-line. The ferrymen honor it and the salvors pretend not to.

acc_belt_high.description: A broad hide belt laced with silver rings, hung with every tool a long campaign asks for.

acc_belt_reclaimer.description: Salvage-hung holsters, a magnet clip, and forty years of burned-in grease. Every pocket has a story; two of them have rations.

acc_belt_skyforged.description: A girdle of skyforged plate, worn by the few who have walked the top rung and come back down.

acc_belt_sunforged.description: A girdle of sunforged plate and hide, cut for the one who carries the whole column's kit.

acc_belt_titanhide.description: A girdle of hide and banded plate, cut for the one who carries the whole column's kit.

acc_belt_zenithforged.description: A girdle of zenithforged plate, worn by the few who have walked the top rung and come back down.

acc_bracelet_copper.description: A hammered copper band worn at the wrist. It buys no luck; it only reminds the arm to keep working.

acc_bracelet_high.description: A banded bracelet of pale metal and braided cord, cut for the wrist that steadies the blade.

acc_bracelet_skyforged.description: A skyforged cuff, cold to the touch and light as a held breath. The wrist forgets it is wearing anything.

acc_bracelet_starmetal.description: A starmetal band seated over a woven lining. It does not loosen, and neither does the wrist it steadies.

acc_bracelet_sunforged.description: A sunforged cuff over braided cord, warm at the wrist through the coldest ascent.

acc_bracelet_tide.description: A bracelet of braided kelp and shore-iron, worn where the pulse shows. The harbor-folk say it knows the current before the water does.

acc_bracelet_titanhide.description: A titanhide cuff over a woven lining, laced tight at the forearm. It does not slip, whatever the hand is doing.

acc_bracelet_zenithforged.description: A zenithforged cuff, cold to the touch and light as a held breath. The wrist forgets it is wearing anything.

acc_breather_abyss_pearl.description: An abyss pearl on a braided kelp cord. The reed keeps the deep at a distance; the pearl is different -- it is a piece of the deep that decided to help. Eight breaths the sea cannot count, twenty more meters the squeeze forgives, and the water's slow pull does not reach the diver at all.

acc_breather_lungshell.description: A spiral shell the size of a head, mouth-blown through its apex by divers who swear it 'remembers the air'. Four breaths for every one, and the squeeze line opens eight meters deeper -- the shelf's far wall is suddenly a swim, not a wall.

acc_breather_reed.description: A marsh reed cut at dawn, bored through with a hot wire. Doesn't look like much -- but cup it in your teeth and the water lets you stay twice as long, and the squeeze of the deep forgives two more meters.

acc_cloak_saltworn.description: A cloak of tarred cord and salvage cloth. It sheds the spray and keeps the smell of the road.

acc_cloak_skyforged.description: A cloak that hangs a half-breath lighter than the hand expects, cut from the sky's own salvage.

acc_cloak_stormwrought.description: A cloak of layered salvage cloth, tarred against the high wind and the long walk down.

acc_cloak_sunforged.description: A mantle woven with dawn thread, warm in the cold and cool in the heat. It has opinions about weather.

acc_cloak_titanhide.description: A cloak of titanhide, cured over a full season. Nothing high and nothing cold gets through it.
