acc_cloak_wanderer.description: Patchwork over an old-world thermal weave. Rain beads off it, and campfire smoke follows it long after you leave.

acc_cloak_zenithforged.description: A cloak of zenithforged weave, cured over a full season. Nothing high and nothing cold gets through it.

acc_necklace_haven_pearl.description: A river pearl on braided sinew, traded at the village docks for more than it is worth. Keeps a calm head when the water rises.

acc_necklace_highward.description: A warded bead on a braided cord, cut for the ones who stand where the frontier thins out.

acc_necklace_paleshard_ward.description: A mythril shard pried loose and strung over an abyss pearl on braided kelp. The pearl keeps the ward fed; the kelp keeps it honest; neither agrees with the other.

acc_necklace_pearl_sigil.display_name: Pearl Sigil of the Deep Sentinel
acc_necklace_pearl_sigil.description: A pearl the trench dreamed around a bone core, strung on braided kelp by whatever hands the Sentinel keeps. The squeeze line reads the dream and labors to obey it: the deep forgives ten more meters, and no current can carry a body wearing the trench's own word.

acc_necklace_sinew.description: A shoal pearl strung on sinew thread. The tide keeps it cool and the wearer keeps it close.

acc_necklace_skyforged.description: A ward-bead of skyforged metal on a woven cord, cut for the highest walk in the world.

acc_necklace_sunforged.description: A dawnstone on a sunforged chain. Held to the light it shows a horizon that is not quite this one.

acc_necklace_titanbone.description: A torc of the same titanbone, worn where the pulse shows. It does not quiet the heart; it steadies it.

acc_necklace_zenithforged.description: A ward-bead of zenithforged metal on a woven cord, cut for the highest walk in the world.

acc_ring_copper_band.description: A plain copper band, filed round and worn smooth. It buys no luck; it just reminds you to keep moving.

acc_ring_first_light.description: Copper wound around a sliver of conduit glass. It warms at dawn -- the harbor-folk say a ring that remembers the sun keeps its wearer standing.

acc_ring_golden_high.description: A tempered-gold band cut with the Concord pillar, worn by those who answer for sums they did not spend.

acc_ring_golden_signet.description: Tempered gold cut with the Concord pillar; the debtor's answer to the creditor's seal. Heavier to wield than to wear.

acc_ring_skyforged.description: A signet cut from a fallen sky-crate's band. It carries the sky's own weight and none of its hurry.

acc_ring_starbinder.description: Starmetal set over its own abyss pearl. The metal stays warm and the pearl stays cold, and the wearer is invited to reconcile the two opinions.

acc_ring_sunforged.description: A ring quenched in the dawn tide, warm to the touch long after the sun has gone.

acc_ring_tidecaller.description: Braided kelp around a smith's iron band. Grown wet and dried slow; the harbor-folk swear it always knows which way the current runs.

acc_ring_titanbone.description: A ring of titanbone bound in silver, heavy enough to be felt and light enough to forget.

acc_ring_zenithforged.description: A zenithforged signet, cut at the top rung and signed once. It remembers every hand it has passed to.

recipe_abyssal_breather.description: One trench pearl strung on eight strands of kelp fiber -- the cord is the part the quay knows how to tie, the pearl is the part nobody explains. The result keeps a diver alive and still.

recipe_copper_band.description: One copper ingot, filed round and worn smooth before it is ever worn. It buys no luck.

recipe_copper_cleaver.description: Copper takes an edge quickly and loses it just as fast. Two ingots and a cord-wrapped haft make a tool that will do the job once, honestly.

recipe_copper_helm.description: Two copper ingots beaten over a leather lining. It turns a glancing blow; the rest is up to you.

recipe_copper_ingot.description: Two copper ores, one ingot, and the slag the forge always keeps. Copper bends before it breaks.

recipe_elixir_ironblood.description: The ore must be ground fine enough to swear into. Two grits, one petal, and a steady hand.

recipe_golden_estoc.description: A thin blade wants patient hands: gold wraps the iron core, the core keeps the opinion.

recipe_golden_ingot.description: Gold melts at a disloyal temperature. Two ores, one ingot, and the crucible keeps a little of the profit.

recipe_golden_scale_chest.description: Each scale taps down flat; a coat this soft starts with iron discipline.

recipe_golden_signet.description: One golden ingot, one silver: gold for the face, silver for the shank the deep bothers. The pillar stamps where the charter says it must.

recipe_iron_axe.description: The head is three ingots of iron; the haft one timber the splitter chose itself.

recipe_iron_dagger.description: One ingot folded twice. A short blank, a patient smith, nine inches of resolve.

recipe_iron_ingot.description: Two ores, one honest ingot. The forge does the work; the ingot carries it.

recipe_iron_mail_chest.description: Five ingots draw to wire, the wire rings, the rings rivet. A craft for hands that do not mind a long afternoon.

recipe_iron_spear.description: A straight head drawn to a point, a timber haft dressed square at the socket.

recipe_longbow.description: Three laminae of timber, steamed and bent with real care. The string is a kelp cord the quay folk braid dry -- it has never once chafed wet.

recipe_mythril_gauntlets.description: Mythril-shard knuckles riveted over sinew-wrapped plate. Light enough to work in, hard enough to end the argument.

recipe_mythril_halberd.description: Two ingots on a haft the workbench cut square. The pale metal leaves the edge to the last pass.

recipe_mythril_ingot.description: The pale ore refuses a lone fire. A golden ingot carries the temper through; the mythril forgives the gold being there.

recipe_mythril_shard.description: A mythril ore struck along its grain, splitting into shards the blade-smiths gather. Too small to forge alone, too proud to throw away.

recipe_mythril_shortblade.description: Mythril shards gathered and forged back into a blade. The metal remembers its temper; the smith only has to remind it.

recipe_mythril_wardmail.description: Ten thousand rings drawn finer than wire. The guards in the collar are signed; the smith declines to say by whom.

recipe_paleshard_ward.description: Workbench, quiet room, no smoking. The mythril shard is cut thin, the pearl bored, the kelp braids double at the knot where the ward catches.

recipe_potion_health_medium.description: Two moonpetals into barley syrup, one mooncap to wake the cauldron's yeast. Stir sunwise for a proper sunburned honey.

recipe_potion_mana_small.description: One cap steeped cold, one petal for the dreaming. The vials must not be shaken.

recipe_reed_breather.description: A dawn-cut marsh reed bored through with a hot wire. Hand-crafted anywhere the marsh gives; the water lets you stay twice as long.

recipe_saltworn_cloak.description: Salvage plate and tarred cord stitched into a cloak that sheds the spray. It keeps the smell of the road.

recipe_silver_ingot.description: The pale ore hates the forge less if the fire is patient. Two ores, one ingot, a little more slag.

recipe_silver_rapier.description: Silver drawn thin and sinew-wrapped at the grip. Three ingots buy a blade that argues in a straight line.

recipe_silver_scale_legs.description: Scale plates sewn over silver-studded leather at the bench. Heavy at the knee, honest at the seam.

recipe_silver_warhammer.description: A silver head on a timber haft, weighted to fall. Four ingots for a hammer that does not need to be quick.

recipe_sinew_strand.description: A shoal pearl strung on doubled sinew thread at the bench. The tide keeps it cool.

recipe_starbinder_ring.description: A starmetal bezel over an abyss pearl. Nothing else sells the pairing -- the metal must stay warm and the pearl must stay cold, and the setting takes the argument.

recipe_starmetal_bulwark.description: Plate for the plate-deaf. The charters call it a civic service an armorer does the Concord; the Concord calls it a favor it will remember.

recipe_starmetal_ingot.description: Sky metal comes full and wants the deepest binder in the book. Two ores, one mythril, and a fire the forge only lends at night.

recipe_starmetal_skysplitter.description: Three ingots and a mooncap for the grip -- the resin keeps hands warm against metal that stays cold-headed always. The forge remembers each one it finishes.

recipe_tea_mooncap_steep.description: Two caps, one petal, a slow fire. The broth knits; the flask keeps.

recipe_tidecaller_ring.description: Badge wet, dry slow, iron last. The kelp pulls the fit toward the water and the band signs its own shape.

recipe_walnut_staff.description: A moon-grown walnut blank, planed true; a silver ferrule the smith set by hand and a mooncap bred for the grip's resin.

recipe_weaver_kite.description: Six billets of pine and a tail stone to keep the nose honest. The workbench does the sewing; the wind does the rest.

buff_aggro_horn.description: Generating maximum threat on all nearby enemies.

buff_ancestral_guardian.description: An ancestral spirit defends you, absorbing damage and healing.

buff_battle_cry_dmg.description: Attack power increased from battle cry.

buff_damage_shunt.description: Incoming damage is redistributed to shields.

buff_deaggro.description: Threat has been reset - enemies have lost interest.

buff_earthshield.description: Damage reduced and receiving periodic healing.

buff_emergency_override.description: Massive damage reduction from emergency systems.

buff_enchant_weapon.description: Weapon attacks deal bonus spell damage.

buff_energy_transfer.description: Mana has been restored by energy transfer.

buff_haste.description: Movement and attack speed increased by 20%.

buff_intervene.description: A portion of damage is being absorbed for you.

buff_last_stand.description: Immune to death. Maximum threat generated.

buff_mana_shield.description: Incoming damage is absorbed by mana.

buff_overcharge.description: Attack and cast speed dramatically increased.

buff_overclock_ally.description: Processing cycles accelerated. Attack and cast speed increased.

buff_reflect.description: A portion of melee damage is reflected to attackers.

buff_rune_ward.description: Protective rune absorbs damage and reflects some back.

buff_sanctuary_aura.description: Receiving passive healing and damage reduction.

buff_shield_wall.description: All damage taken is dramatically reduced.

buff_storm_aura.description: Attack speed increased. Nearby enemies take damage.

buff_time_anchor.description: Immune to all slow and speed effects.

debuff_aggro_horn.description: This unit is the target of an aggro horn. Maximum threat on them.

debuff_armor_reduce.description: Armor has been reduced by the shield strike.

debuff_clock_surge.description: Processing cycles erratic. Movement and actions slowed.

debuff_full_stall.description: All processes frozen. Cannot move, act, or regenerate.

debuff_hex.description: Damage and movement speed reduced by a curse.

debuff_marked.description: Target has been revealed and marked for the party.

debuff_redirect.description: Targeting system corrupted. Next attack will miss and redirect.

debuff_regen_mitigate.description: Health and mana regeneration are suppressed.

debuff_silence.description: Cannot cast spells or use abilities.

debuff_taunt.description: Forced to attack the source of the taunt.

debuff_tick_slow.description: Processing frequency reduced. All actions slowed.

debuff_time_stop.description: Time has stopped. Cannot move or act.

debuff_time_warp.description: Time moves slowly around this unit.

debuff_wall_block.description: Movement is blocked by a barrier.

stealth_deep.description: Heavy shadow concealment. Reduces detection range by 60%. Breaks on damage or combat actions.

stealth_light.description: Soft shadow concealment. Reduces detection range by 30%. Breaks on taking damage.

stealth_vanish.description: Complete removal from enemy awareness. Zero detection radius. Breaks only on taking direct damage.

npc_armory_capital.description: The capital's premier source for weapons and armor.
npc_armory_capital.greeting: Fine arms and armor, straight from the forge.

npc_banker_capital.description: The Concord's ledger keeper at the strand: deposits screened, withdrawals sealed, bullion stored below the plaza.
npc_banker_capital.greeting: The Concord vault honors every posted rate.

npc_banker_village.description: The keep's vault keeper. Deposits, withdrawals, and the safe-keeping of coin that adventurers lose to the sea.
npc_banker_village.greeting: Coin or keepsakes? The vault holds both.

npc_black_market_fixer.description: The underdeck's quietest stall keeps no face and takes no coin it cannot trace. Scrap in, scrip out -- and for the sigils nobody mints, the deep vault ledger signs for itself.
npc_black_market_fixer.greeting: You found this stall. Nobody showed you.

npc_blacksmith_capital.description: The Concord's forge at the strand. Same repair law, better leather -- the city smith runs the Concord rate book.
npc_blacksmith_capital.greeting: City rates, city work. Bring the worn gear.

npc_blacksmith_village.description: The local blacksmith serving a small rural community.
npc_blacksmith_village.greeting: Good to see ye, traveler. Bring me yer worn gear.

npc_concord_herald.description: Keeper of the pillared shrine on the capitol strand -- the Concord's honest out. Steed deeds and degree stakes are sealed at this pillar; the sigils the webhook armor delivers go out here, never bartered, never buried.
npc_concord_herald.greeting: The pillar keeps its own ledger. Sigils in, deeds out -- and the Concord never buries a coin.

npc_deep_warden.description: Keeper of the Root Camp. The Warden counts the glow tides and tends the first hearth ever lit down here.
npc_deep_warden.greeting: You came down the sky way, or up from nothing? Either way: the glow tide is rising. Sit.

npc_elder_capital.description: The Concord's town warden on the baywalk. The same taught-lore the village elder carries, at city reach.
npc_elder_capital.greeting: Union memory. The Baywalk wants your way home too.

npc_ferryman_sundered.description: He kept the crossing alive when the strait closed. Now that the Sundered Sea is open again, the barque sails twice a tide -- if someone pays the crew.
npc_ferryman_sundered.greeting: Tide's turning. You crossing, or just gawking at the wreck?
npc_ferryman_sundered.farewell: Mind the shoal. She took the barque; she'll take slower ships.

npc_herbalist_capital.description: The Concord's herb counter on the baywalk. The same draughts the village sells, kept in sea-glass jars.
npc_herbalist_capital.greeting: Sea air needs different teas. Browse the shelf.

npc_herbalist_village.description: A village herbalist specializing in potions and remedies.
npc_herbalist_village.greeting: Welcome! I have remedies for what ails you.

npc_jeweler_haven.description: Marsh Piper, the shore's pearl-cutting jeweler. She braids kelp, cuts abyss pearls, and prices the Concord's debt steel off her own bench.
npc_jeweler_haven.greeting: Careful with that on my bench, dear. Everything here has already been one tragedy (pearl, dive, or debt).
npc_jeweler_haven.farewell: Mind the clasp of anything you bought from me. The sea tests hasty work.

npc_merchant_capital.description: The gift-trade bourse at the cove: the same stock the village store carries, at Concord rates.
npc_merchant_capital.greeting: The cove carries everything. Names your want.
npc_merchant_capital.farewell: Mind the pier, it is slick.

npc_merchant_general.description: A traveling merchant selling various goods.
npc_merchant_general.greeting: Take a look at my wares!

npc_salvor_wreck.description: She charts the wreck shoal by memory and claims the barque's hold is still full. Nobody has paid her diving fee to find out.
npc_salvor_wreck.greeting: You'll be wanting rope, boots, and nerve. The shoal takes all three.
npc_salvor_wreck.farewell: Bring back what the water kept, and we'll talk coin.

npc_skill_academy_capital.description: A seasoned master who teaches warriors the ancient arts of combat mastery. Choose your signature ability at level 10.
npc_skill_academy_capital.greeting: Greetings, warrior. Would you like to expand your combat knowledge or choose your signature ability?
npc_skill_academy_capital.farewell: May your blade stay sharp. Return when you are ready to learn more.

npc_skill_academy_village.description: A retired campaign warden who drills the village's young fighters. The Academy's reach is long -- the basics are taught wherever a student stands.
npc_skill_academy_village.greeting: Feet square, blade steady. What shall we drill?

npc_tidewright_fenwick.description: Old Fenwick, the shore's plankwright. He built the strait's two moor banks and rebuilt the barque's deck six times, and rents timber out of the same yard slats to whomever the fences pay for.
npc_tidewright_fenwick.greeting: Mind the tar bucket, the yard's wet through. Half this village's fence is my hand and the other half is what the tide takes back come the next blow.
npc_tidewright_fenwick.farewell: Keep clear of the wet slats. The fence outlasts tempers, and it outlasted yours too, most likely.

npc_village_elder.description: The elder of Haven village, keeper of ancient lore.
npc_village_elder.greeting: Welcome, traveler. The village has been troubled by wolves...

sign_the_awakening.description: The horizon splits along a seam of pale light. The oldest of the Concord's signs: what slept is waking, and the sky remembers it first.
sign_the_awakening.observation_hint: Seen at first light in the eastern sky.

sign_the_sunken_choir.description: Faint points of light arrange below the horizon line, as if a constellation had drowned and kept singing. Not an omen of loss: an anthem that outlived the singer.
sign_the_sunken_choir.observation_hint: Only visible when the moon is dark.

sign_the_wandering_grove.description: A cluster of green-white lights that drifts across the sky over the hours, rooted in nothing. The Concord read it as proof that home is a thing you carry.
sign_the_wandering_grove.observation_hint: Tracked by the caravan folk; it leans toward wherever most people gathered that day.

mystery_the_first_vault.display_name: The Vault That Answered the Sky
mystery_the_first_vault.riddle: The first vault kept one question above its door, and its builders claimed the answer was already written -- nightly, overhead, for anyone who kept the ledger of lights. Speak the four words in the order the sky said them on the day the vault last answered.
mystery_the_first_vault.hint: The Concord's almanac re-derives any past day's code. Which day did the vault open? Act I remembers.

mystery_the_watcher_tally.riddle: A warden's slate lists every figure the Concord keeps in its sky-ledger. Count the signs the shard has catalogued, and speak the tally.
mystery_the_watcher_tally.hint: Not the sky's rotation -- the ledger itself. How many signs does the almanac know?

act_1_the_first_vault.description: The oldest record in the Chronicle. A city that planned four hundred years ahead and died anyway -- what remains is not ruins, it is a curriculum.

chapters.record_text: The first vault's doors were rated in generations, not seasons. The builders wrote their work orders for heirs they would never meet: 'to those who keep what we kept.' Every mechanism still turns. Nobody is left who remembers why.

The vault stores no treasure. Its deepest chamber holds a planning ledger and one line, struck through: 'the city will outlast the need for cities.' The Concord reads this as a caution: planning is not the same as knowing.
The vault kept a room where citizens filed objections to their own plans -- and the plans waited for them. The Concord keeps the room open. Attention, not certainty, is what made it work.

act_2_the_unpaid_debt.description: The dead built what you live in. This act reads the maintenance logs they left behind -- obligations without owners, kept anyway.

chapters.record_text: A conduit line has been re-wound every eleven years since before the Bloom. The log holds 214 signatures and one instruction, addressed to nobody: 'rewind it again.' Nobody was paid. Everybody was obliged.

The wardens refused replacement parts when the originals could be mended. Their reason, on file: 'a spare teaches you nothing; a mend teaches you the whole.' The Skill Academy still teaches from their mends.

The final maintenance log has no repair entry at all -- only a roster of names and, beside each, the name of another. Every name appears twice: once as keeper, once as kept. The roster was the repair.

act_3_the_trust_audit.description: Vault records from a society that ran on trust audits instead of commandments. No enforcement -- only attention, and the shared expectation of it.

chapters.record_text: The audit chamber has no lock. Its door reads: 'you were trusted to arrive.' Records show 400 years of arrivals, and the ledgers reconcile to the coin. The Concord never duplicated the design; it duplicated the expectation.
A wheat shortage was answered by an unlocked granary and a sign-up sheet, not guards. The sheet came back overfilled. The auditors' note on the surplus: 'the community kept the audit for us.'

The last audit found nothing to correct and the auditors filed it anyway -- a clean sheet is a record too. The Concord's custom of the daily tally descends from that filing: attention is the audit, not the finding.

loot_bandit.name: Bandit Loot
loot_bandit.description: Drops from Bandit enemies. Road-dogs rob ore carts as much as coin: their hauls carry silver and golden seam.

loot_black_market_depths.name: Fixer's Depths Pull
loot_black_market_depths.description: The Underdeck Fixer's deep pull: 12 sigils rides the pressure where the rare gear dreams. Documented shape: as higher-tier weapons/armors arrive (data/weapons, data/armors), append entries and the roll honors them.

loot_black_market_tide.name: Fixer's Tide Pull
loot_black_market_tide.description: The Underdeck Fixer's cheap tide-pull: 3 sigils rides the shallow wash where odds still breathe. Documented shape: append real entries here and the roll honors them.

loot_bloom_corruption.name: Bloom Corruption
loot_bloom_corruption.description: What the Bloom leaves behind in the things it takes: violet-capped spores, a shard of the mycelium mantle, and the mooncap that grows wherever the runoff pools. One drop in a hundred is the ore the roots bit down past the frost line.

loot_coast_bounty.name: Coast Bounty
loot_coast_bounty.description: What the island's thieves and nesters haul together: wreck kelp, drowned pearls pried off the reef edge, and the brass the sea never counts honest. One coin in ten still carries a mint mark.

loot_copper_seam.name: Copper Seam
loot_copper_seam.description: The low seams give up their copper a handful at a time: green-veined ore, the grit the wheel leaves, and slag the forge always keeps.

loot_elite_ore.name: Elite Seam Drops
loot_elite_ore.description: Ore from elite and boss pursuits. The big guards carry the deep grades: troll caches hold golden and starmetal, and what a void lord sheds is beyond (starmetal always, mythril vanishingly).

loot_gloam_litter.name: Gloam Litter
loot_gloam_litter.description: The gloam holds what its tenants scraped up: iron out of old field burrows, silver the roots bit, and the mushrooms nobody harvests honest.

loot_gloam_spores.name: Gloam Spores
loot_gloam_spores.description: The polyps and hides of the deep bloom carry their own medicine in the gills: dried cap, brewable steep, and a pale ore the root bit down past the frost line. One gem in a hundred is real.

loot_high_marches.name: High Marches Drops
loot_high_marches.description: What the mid-high country pays out: silver and mythril gear from the lower rungs, starmetal from the deep seam, and the first of the sunforged pieces from the ones that hold the high crags.

loot_meadow_litter.name: Meadow Litter
loot_meadow_litter.description: What the meadow's tenants carry or leave behind: dropped bite-rations, the odd shed timber, and the wild cap or petal their Owners never planted.

loot_pan_dust.name: Pan Dust
loot_pan_dust.description: What the salt keeps after the brine drains: silver in crust, iron in marrow, and the flat stone the pans set like coins. The hounds carry their shimmer in dust.

loot_salvage_yard.name: Salvage Yard
loot_salvage_yard.description: What the wrecks leave behind: hammered plate, conduit wire pulled whole, the odd tide token, and dust the bench swept up.

loot_skill_books.name: Skill Book Drops
loot_skill_books.description: Drops epic/legendary skill books. Attach to elite and boss enemies. Book item ids (book_<skill>_<tier>) are expanded to runtime SkillBook items by GroundLootService via SkillAcademyService.create_book. Common and rare books are purchased at the Skill Academy.

loot_sky_crate_daily.name: Sky Crate Daily Loot
loot_sky_crate_daily.description: Rewards from the Concord's daily sky observation crate. Contents lean toward coin and soul; storm days may yet surprise.

loot_skyward_reach.name: Skyward Reach Drops
loot_skyward_reach.description: The top rungs pay out: sunforged and skyforged gear from the long ascent and the outer air, carried by the few things that live that high. Salvage of the sky's own make, cut for the walk nobody comes back down from unchanged.

loot_slime.name: Slime Loot
loot_slime.description: Drops from Slime enemies. Mostly gel and junk; even the junk includes common seam-ore (slimes sift the ground).

loot_sunken_salvage.name: Sunken Salvage
loot_sunken_salvage.description: What a tidecursed body trails up and what the kelp net snagged after them. The dig-grade fibers keep their shape; the pearls stayed whole because the sea wanted them back anyway; and somewhere in the drag someone still had a vial in their teeth.

loot_trench_dream.name: Trench Dream Drops
loot_trench_dream.description: What the Sentinel carries up from past the squeeze line. The pearl it grows around is the trench's own dream: whoever wears it hears the squeeze line loosen. The ores are the garden's debris caught in its kelp net -- the deep grades, shed honestly.

loot_wolf.name: Wolf Loot
loot_wolf.description: Drops from Grey Wolf enemies. Pack carriers bite for seam-iron: copper shows up crushed in the denmaw.

loot_zenith_reach.name: Zenith Reach Drops
loot_zenith_reach.description: What the last rung pays: the zenithforged gear the Concord signs only for hands it has watched, carried by the old-order things that still keep the highest ledges. The top of the ladder, and nothing above it.

aurora_window.notify_message: An aurora unfolds - the sky is writing. Something may be answered.

bloom_stir.notify_message: The sky turns active over the gloam - something the Bloom took is walking out of the trees.

fog_mystery.notify_message: Fog settles low - shapes watch from the treeline. The sky listens tonight.

kp_gate.notify_message: The tempest burns green - the gate is open. Answer it.

storm_pack.notify_message: The storm stirs the wilds - something is coming.

ankh_village_shrine.description: A sacred ankh for binding your spirit.

dungeon_forest_depths_entrance.description: A dark portal leading into the depths of the forest.

waypoint_capitol_pier.description: The Baywalk's ferry berth: the timber pier off the city strand where the Haven Ferry calls between tides. The bay opens toward the island.

waypoint_island_dock.description: A salt-worn waypoint at the island's only break in the cliffs. The ferry knows it by heart.

waypoint_nexus_central.description: An old-world waypoint stone flickering teal, answering the roads toward the dormant capital.

waypoint_shipwreck_quay.description: The headland quay the salvor calls home: a rope rack, a drum of pitch, and a shelf of things the strait gave back. The shoal ford starts here at low water.

waypoint_strait_moor.description: The moat-side ferry pin: the barque casts off from the shadow of the near headland, where the channel opens toward the sea.

waypoint_strait_seaward.description: The open-water ferry pin past the wreck shoal, where the barque turns for the open sea and the headlands sink behind you.

waypoint_sun_pans.description: A salt-scoured waypoint on the atoll's outer bank. The ferry knows the bearing; the pans' furnace heat does the rest.

waypoint_village_center.description: The village harbor's shared berth: the mystical waypoint stones above the strand where the bay barge and the island skiff both moor -- two boats know this pin.

lava_underglow_lake.lore: The Deep Root's own fire: a slow lake of strata-melt that pools where the shell sweats magma. The Warden does not count its crossings. It drifts a palm's width east every clock -- the lake licks the wall in the same direction the glow tide runs. Nothing lives in it and nothing ever crossed twice.

ocean_deep_root_pool.lore: The Deep Root's own water: the Concord cistern at the camp shelf catches the glow tide high and keeps it sweet. The Warden calls it the pool that remembers the surface. Nothing lives in it -- nothing has ever tried. Swim it once and the strata glow holds your outline longer than it should.

ocean_haven_shelf.lore: West of Haven the green world remembers it was once all water. The reef gardens start shallow; the kelp keeps the middle dark; the trench keeps whatever it keeps. The Concord charted the shelf top to bottom -- what lives below the light is the sea's own business.

ocean_lunar_crater.lore: The builders filled a crater to learn what water is, and the dish kept growing until it was an inland sea: three hundred and sixty paces across, two hundred deep, filled to within a stone's throw of its own rim. Tame by design -- no squeeze, no crush, a slow turn the way the pale stone turns -- the workshop pool where the world works on itself. Whatever swims here first swims on the moon.

ocean_sundered_sea.lore: After the sundering the sea took the west face whole. The reef gardens wait just past the light; the kelp keeps the middle dark; the trench at the far bank holds whatever the shelf was willing to lose. The Concord charter says the sea is landing -- its currents say ferry.

biome_underworld_crag_ring.lore: The ring ridge: twelve leaning slabs the shell dropped on its own doorstep. One in three carries veins the strata lights, so the ring reads even when the tide sleeps. Every third leaning slab keeps a stone-sweet swerve away from the camp's two gates.

biome_underworld_dead_grove.lore: The green world's bones: seven charcoal trunks standing where a forest once had a claim. The Deep Root keeps them bare -- no light under the strata feeds leaves, and the Warden finds bare forks more honest than fake color.

biome_underworld_mycelium_field.lore: The understory light: nine clumps of glow caps pooled between the crags. The strata feeds the shelf and the fungi answer -- a body walking the field steps over the glow, never through it, and the caps never block a boot.

biome_underworld_odd_grasses.lore: The Deep Root's one honest soft edge: odd luminous grasses scattered through every band, thin as needles and gentle as a promise. The dark meadow has no other purpose than to be walked through -- grass never blocks a foot.

biome_underworld_stalagmite_runs.lore: Where the shell sweats, pale stone grows slow and patient: fourteen spikes in sheltered lanes. Each stands as a wall a climber can own, not a shrub a body pushes through -- the shell's patience is PropCollider law.

dwel_anvil_iron.description: A blacksmith's anvil for your hall. Repair worn blades at home -- no more hauling to the village smithy. Interact once placed to open the smithy at this anvil.

dwel_cauldron_brew.description: A squat cauldron over a low flame. The alchemy station awaits its recipes; placing it now prepares your hall for them.

dwel_fireplace_stone.description: A cozy stone fireplace. Provides ambient warmth and lighting.

dwel_forge_coal.description: A house forge fed by charcoal bellows. Smelts ore and hammers ingots at home, failure roll and all. Interact once placed to open the craft table at the FORGE.

dwel_wooden_chair.description: A simple wooden chair. Perfect for any dining room.

dwel_workbench_oak.description: A sturdy carpenter's bench for your hall. Sew kites and tinker trinkets at home. Interact once placed to open the craft table at the WORKBENCH.

glider_drift_kite.description: A ridged linen wing on a willow frame. Snap it open over a drop and the valley slows down beneath you.

glider_gullwing_shade.description: A gull-boned frame under dyed canvas, tuned by the harbor wind-readers. Holds a thermal like it owes it something.

glider_reclaimer_ribs.description: A wing of salvaged alloy ribs and patched membrane, carried up the Spire rung by rung. The favor that bought it is sewn into every seam.

glider_sewn_swallow.description: A swallow-cut wing stitched from retted flax. Answers a lean before you finish making it.

glider_storm_spine.description: A spine of storm-forged struts carrying a wing of woven sky. It does not fall so much as choose where the ground happens.

glider_weaver_kite.description: A workbench kite: pine spars, flax web, and a stone-weighted tail. The cheapest wings in the reclaim that still answer a lean -- the training kite a carpenter sews for their own first jump.

launcher_haven_spire.lore: Rings of old-world alloy, humming faintly. The elders say the ancients did not build stairs -- they built throws.

launcher_meadow_gate.lore: Two standing stones and a basin of cool fire. It waits for the shard to remember how to wake it.

thermal_ascent_thrower.lore: The ancients built one door out of the Deep Root and one throw up to it: a stone ring by the Ascent that hurls a wake rider into the deep dark, where the wings catch the East Stack and ride the wall's own currents. It sleeps until the shard says the mystery moves -- the underworld's launcher, dormant like every other piece of the old machine (prd-mystery land).

thermal_coliseum_bowl.lore: Ten thousand shouted duels warmed the air in the bowl. The sky remembers a crowd.

thermal_haven_rise.lore: The warm breath of the valley, rising off the hearth-stones since before the village had a name.

thermal_meadow_column.lore: Pollens and warm air braid together here; the birds learned the spiral before the people did.

thermal_underworld_vent_east.lore: A crack in the shell that breathes upward always: the Deep Root's standing column. The wing folk circle it the way surface fliers ride the Concord lift -- the underworld's air answered the roof fell and never stopped asking why.

thermal_underworld_vent_flow.lore: The gentle vein: a smaller crack that exhales over the mycelium field. The Warden says the flow vein is the underworld's own breath -- slow, patient, and waking nobody.

thermal_valley_east.lore: A rift-draft climbing off the eastern scar. The marshals pretend they do not use it to reposition.

thermal_valley_west.lore: The western wall exhales at dusk. Drop-disengage, ride, and fall back into the circle before the fog forgets you.
